description: Source code for the RemotePlugin class implementing a plugin interface for RustAdapter, including socket communication, process management, and JSON-RPC handling.

classes.name: RemotePlugin
classes.description: A plugin class managing socket communication, process launching, and JSON-RPC message handling for RustAdapter.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, opens socket, and optionally spawns remote process.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closes socket, and waits for remote process to exit.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends JSON message to a specified channel.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC invocation, sends request over socket.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a channel and sends attach message.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a channel and sends detach message.

methods.name: LaunchRemoteProcess
methods.description: Launches remote process with shared library, host IP, and port.
